ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why variance is real and one losing month proves nothing
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text: One losing month doesn't mean the system is broken.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text: Most bettors quit after a bad run. They think the picks stopped working. Usually, variance just had its say.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text: A 54% win rate is genuinely profitable long-term. But over any 20-game sample, that same bettor can go 8-12. Coin flips cluster. That's math, not failure.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text: Example: flip a fair coin 20 times. You'll land 8 or fewer heads about 25% of the time. Betting at 54% is better than a coin flip, but short samples still swing hard. A 20-game losing skid at 54% true win rate happens to roughly 1 in 14 bettors in any given stretch.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text: The edge shows up over hundreds of bets, not dozens. We're 259-221 across 49 days logged. One rough week is noise. The record is the signal.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: One losing month is noise. The edge lives in the full sample. 259-221, +40.1u, 49 days logged. That's the record.
